sources.snippet: The code is organized in the following modules: Head: A single head of self-attention. MultiHead: Multiple heads of self-attention. FeedForward: A straightforward fully connected layer. MultiHeadAttentionBlock: A block of attention followed by computation. tinyTransformer: The main model class implementing the transformer architecture.

sources.snippet: Residual + LayerNorm to stabilize everything. Now it's time to assemble a complete GPT-style language model. Think of it like building a house: we've poured the foundation (embeddings), installed the plumbing and wiring (attention), and added rooms (blocks). The Tiny Transformer is the full house, ready to be lived in. Step 1.
